blurb: Sail Fish Scuba offers small group guided scuba diving and snorkeling tours exploring reefs and wrecks in Key Largo. Every recreational dive includes a professional PADI guide in the water and complimentary underwater photos. They also provide gear rentals, air fills, and PADI certification courses.
